Company turnover by week

Miele SDA, Samsung TV and LG TV are separate lines. Miele MDA, Samsung MDA and LG MDA show their remaining sales. Appliance City is excluded from this table; Company headline totals include all eligible report rows. Accessories and All Departments categories are ignored throughout.

Five best-selling models per category

Categories are ordered by total turnover in the selected week, highest first. Models are ranked by units; turnover breaks ties. Categories with fewer than five models show all available models.

How the figures are calculated

Accessories and All Departments categories are ignored throughout: rows with Access or the category All Departments in Group ID or Group ID2 are excluded from turnover, unit counts, comparisons and top models. All Departments in Group ID3 alone does not exclude a valid category. All Quooker products are included in weekly brand turnover and company totals, regardless of accessory or category labels. Turnover = sum of PriceEx, excluding VAT. Each CSV row counts as one unit; this export has no quantity or return flag. Negative values are included in turnover and their rows still count as one unit. Weeks run Monday–Sunday. Change = selected week minus the immediately preceding calendar week; percentage = change ÷ previous week × 100. A zero baseline shows “New” or “—”. A missing comparison week shows “No data”, never a fabricated zero. Coverage flags use the report’s date range and do not establish whether an export is complete. Miele SDA, Samsung TV and LG TV appear separately and are excluded from their parent brand rows, so the total counts each sale once. TV includes TV + Audio; Miele SDA includes Floorcare and Small Appliances. No order references, barcodes or costs are stored in this dashboard.
